subject: Request: Temporary PO waiver for GreenForge pilot billing and onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@greenforge.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Anand <priya@greenforge.io>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding + short pilot — PO waiver?

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get started. We have a small paid pilot (4 weeks) and procurement at GreenForge is asking for a PO on any vendor billing. Our finance team is flexible for pilot engagements but it slows things down (~2 weeks).

Two asks:
- Is there any temporary path to invoice-only billing for the pilot so we can begin next week?
- If needed, we can sign a short SOW and provide a W-9 and corporate insurer cert.

Attached: GreenForge_Onboarding_Form.pdf, GF_SOW_v1.pdf, supplier_w9.pdf

Not urgent but would love a quick yes/no so we can align timelines.

Best,
Samir Shah
Director, Partnerships
GreenForge Labs
samir@greenforge.io

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@greenforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + short pilot — PO waiver?

Hi Samir — thanks for the materials and the fast follow. Great to hear the demo landed well.

Quick answers:
- We can often accommodate a temporary invoice-only path for short pilots, but Finance needs the onboarding packet + W-9 and a signed SOW with clear billing lines (amount, cadence).
- I’ve looped in Marissa (sales ops) to confirm the SOW details and Laura from Finance to sign off on an interim no-PO arrangement.

Next steps for speed:
1) Samir — can you confirm the pilot not-to-exceed amount and preferred billing cadence (one invoice at end of pilot vs two bi-weekly)?
2) I’ll ask Marissa to draft a one-page pilot addendum to our master terms that references the attached GF_SOW_v1.pdf.
3) Laura — is there a standard temporary approval you can use, and any required purchasing codes?

If we can get confirmation today, we’ll route a one-off approval and you should be able to start next week.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

On Mon, Aug 31, 2026 at 09:05 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Quick answers:
> - We can often accommodate a temporary invoice-only path for short pilots...

Samir / Rachel — thanks for the context. I pulled the attachments and made two small edits to the SOW to call out fixed deliverables and an end date so Finance can classify it as a time-boxed engagement. Draft changes are minimal — tracked in GF_SOW_v1_for_redwood.pdf (see attachment stub).

Operational notes:
- For a temporary no-PO path we need: signed SOW, completed onboarding form, W-9, remittance address, and an internal approver (Finance or Ops).
- I recommend single invoice at pilot completion to minimize accounting churn. If GreenForge prefers bi-weekly, we’ll need milestone amounts.
- If approved, we will activate a vendor record in our ERP as "TempInvoiceOnly" and tag the record with HubSpot deal HUBS-98765.

Samir — please confirm: pilot total (USD), billing cadence, and remittance details. Once we have that I can prepare the addendum and route for Laura’s approval.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

On Mon, Aug 31, 2026 at 09:14 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> For a temporary no-PO path we need: signed SOW, completed onboarding form, W-9, remittance address...

All — finance can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilot engagements under $15,000 USD and duration <= 45 days, provided the following are met:
1) Signed SOW clearly showing total and deliverable dates.
2) Completed onboarding form with company legal name and remittance details.
3) Valid W-9 or W-8 and insurer certificate if SLA risk > low.
4) Sales rep (Rachel) to confirm the pilot is not related to long-term contractual commitments beyond the SOW.

If GreenForge confirms pilot total and sends remittance info, I will issue a written "Temp Invoice-Only Approval" email and instruct Procurement to create a vendor record with status TempInvoiceOnly. That vendor record will be flagged to require PO for any future renewals or expansions.

I will not approve open-ended invoice terms; this is strictly for pilots and subject to reversal if obligations change.

—Laura Bennett
Sr. Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Samir — thanks. GreenForge confirms the pilot total is $9,750 USD, single invoice at completion, remittance to: GreenForge Labs, 412 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105, ACH: 111222333 (bank on file). Signed SOW attached (GF_SOW_signed.pdf).

Based on Laura’s conditions above, we are good to proceed. Laura — please consider this the formal request to issue the Temp Invoice-Only Approval and create the vendor record. Marissa — please proceed with the vendor activation and addendum.

Samir — once the vendor record is active I’ll share the onboarding checklist and kickoff calendar. Looking forward to getting you started next week.

Thanks —Rachel
